Fixed image display by using WOImage instead of WOGenericContainer, and optimized photo/location transitions to return nil when staying on the same page, preventing session page reinstantiation.

Added imageWidth and imageHeight properties/bindings to PhotoCapture component, and bound imageWidth='100' in ReviewObservations.wod to scale the image proportionally as a thumbnail, while keeping Capture.wod unchanged.
Spike complete: native RS256 (OpenSSL EVP) + native NSURLSession both confirmed working; findings and recommended build flags recorded in notes for the PhotoStorageMover issue
Observation is now an EOCustomObject following Observer's proven pattern; full test suite green, no regressions, no other files touched
JournalEntry model class added following Observer/Observation pattern; new tests pass, full suite green, no regressions
Service account + bucket-scoped IAM grant + k8s secret gcs-storage-credentials (namespace default, key: key.json) all provisioned and verified
PhotoStorageMover implemented (copy+delete split API, async, emulator-compatible), unit tests pass, verified end-to-end against the real running Firebase Storage emulator

Schema, relationships, and required property additions on Observation/Observer/JournalEntry implemented; model-level correctness verified via 7 new tests plus real-container compilation (including a bug caught: wrong awakeFromInsertion selector name); DB round-trip correctness deferred to staging verification per the issue's own acceptance criteria

Containerfile (GnuTLS) and k8s/deployment.yaml (gcs-storage-credentials mount + env vars) updated; full Containerfile build including make check verified passing end to end for the first time in this epic

saveToJournal + PhotoMigrator implemented; storage.rules gap for permanent photos found and fixed (verified against emulator, applied to production by user); a real GDL2 crash found and fixed (unregistered-object save); verified in both a real local Postgres and the actual no-DB CI container
BrowseJournal implemented and verified; surfaced and fixed a GDL2 production reliability bug along the way

BrowseJournal deleteEntry implemented (BrowseJournal.h/.m/.wod/.html, test/TestBrowseJournal.m): ownership-checked delete, per-observation permanent-photo cleanup via PhotoStorageMover, cascade DB delete via ec deleteObject:+saveChanges. Found and fixed a real bug along the way - deleteEntry initially read observations via JournalEntry.observations' plain accessor, which never resolves (GDL2's to-many array-fault is broken for this relationship, see onthewing-czs.20); fixed by fetching Observations explicitly via EOQualifier, matching -journalEntries' existing pattern. Verified against real Postgres in podman (onthewing-czs.19's new in-container DB stage) - all 21 test suites pass, TestBrowseJournal 5/5, real delete/cascade/photo-delete-count assertions exercised (not the no-DB fallback path).

Containerfile's builder stage now installs and starts a local Postgres before make check (installs postgresql, trusts 127.0.0.1 in pg_hba.conf, creates the onthewing-eedce-database DB - OTWApp -init's existing -initializeDatabase already auto-creates the schema on first connect, no separate migration step needed). Verified: full make check in a clean podman build shows 21/21 suites passing with zero 'no DB available' fallback log lines. Runtime stage unaffected (still only copies /app/OnTheWing.gswa and /usr/local/lib,bin from the builder). This also surfaced a real bug (see onthewing-czs.11's close notes and onthewing-czs.20).

Implemented: Observer gained kFreeTierPhotoLimit (=50) plus -savedPhotoCountInEditingContext:/-remainingPhotoQuotaInEditingContext: as the single source of truth (explicit EOQualifier fetch across journalEntry.observer.uid, counting only Observations with journalEntry != nil AND a non-nil photoURLString - same to-many-faulting workaround as BrowseJournal/onthewing-czs.20). ReviewObservations.saveToJournal now checks pending photos-with-a-photo against remaining quota BEFORE the DB save; over-quota rejects the WHOLE save, leaves Session's pending list untouched, and sets a new ReviewObservations.lastError (NSError) - not yet surfaced in UI, explicitly deferred to onthewing-1yu's flash-message epic, which now has an obvious consumption point. Error copy says 'Upgrade your account to save more' per explicit user direction (not 'delete a photo', since there's no delete-photo-only action and product wants to nudge upgrades). Boundary (50 allowed / 51 rejected) tested precisely and deterministically at the Observer level (test/TestObserver.m, works regardless of DB availability since a never-seen uid has 0 saved photos either way); saveToJournal-level rejection tested in test/TestReviewObservations.m. onthewing-czs.8's notes updated to record the interaction. Verified: 22/22 suites pass in podman against real Postgres, zero no-DB fallback paths hit for the new tests.

discardObservations added to ReviewObservations.h/.m (calls the already-existing Session -removeAllObservationsForReview from the saveToJournal work, then navigates to Main), wired as a 'Discard All' WOHyperlink in ReviewObservations.wod/.html alongside saveToJournalLink/backLink. One new test (testDiscardObservationsEmptiesSessionAndReturnsMainPage). Verified: 22/22 suites pass in podman against real Postgres, TestReviewObservations 12/12.

Main.h/.m gained -browseJournal action (mirrors -reviewObservations), wired as a WOHyperlink shown only for logged-in users (reusing hasUser/is_logged_in, a fresh WOD declaration since element names can't be reused within one template). BrowseJournal.wo already in GNUmakefile from onthewing-czs.10, confirmed. New TestMain.m test.

Also fixed two things found along the way, both verified in the same podman/real-Postgres run:
1. BrowseJournal's empty state now reads 'Get out into nature and record what you see!' with a link to Capture (user-requested), which needed a shared -prepareNewObservation method added to the ObservationUsing protocol/Capture class (Main.m and BrowseJournal.m both had near-identical Observation-construction code inlined - now both just call [capturePage prepareNewObservation], per explicit user request to deduplicate; also fixes a minor pre-existing over-retain in the old inlined code by using autorelease consistently in the new shared implementation).
2. BrowseJournal.wod's observationLoop was bound directly to currentEntry.observations - the same broken to-many GDL2 relationship fault as onthewing-czs.20's deleteEntry finding, but in the actual rendered UI this time, meaning the nested per-entry observation list has been silently empty in production. Fixed via a new -currentEntryObservations method (delegates to the existing explicit-fetch workaround) rebound in the .wod. Noted as a second occurrence in onthewing-czs.20.

Verified: 22/22 suites pass in podman against real Postgres. TestBrowseJournal 8/8 (+3), TestMain 7/7 (+1), TestCapture 3/3 (+1).

local-dev/kustomization.yaml's onthewing Deployment env patch now sets GCS_BUCKET (onthewing-eedce.firebasestorage.app, matching production and the client-side emulator config in FirebaseAuth.js) and GCS_API_BASE_URL (http://firebase-emulator-svc:9199, the in-cluster DNS name for the emulator's Storage port - not localhost, since the app container talks to it over the cluster network unlike the browser). GCS_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY_PATH deliberately left unset per the ticket's design, matching PhotoStorageMover's no-auth-when-unconfigured behavior against the emulator.

Also found and fixed a pre-existing bug while verifying: the existing patch removed /spec/template/spec/volumes entirely but never removed container 0's volumeMounts entry (gcs-storage-credentials-vol), which would fail Kubernetes API validation (dangling volume reference) on any actual apply. Added an explicit remove for /spec/template/spec/containers/0/volumeMounts.

Verified statically via 'kubectl kustomize local-dev' (no live cluster needed) - confirmed env vars render correctly, volumeMounts/volumes/cloud-sql-proxy sidecar are all absent, single container in the pod spec.

NOT verified: the ticket's full acceptance criteria wants a live 'skaffold dev' run with an actual capture->review->save flow confirming the photo moves in the emulator's Storage UI/API. User has taken this on themselves (same manual-verification pattern as onthewing-czs.14) rather than having it done in this session - minikube was stopped and this needs live browser interaction.

Full regression pass, clean: 'make check' equivalent (XCTest + Jest) run in podman against real Postgres via the onthewing-czs.19 in-container DB stage. 22/22 XCTest suites pass, 4/4 Jest suites (29 tests) pass. No skipped/disabled tests. No regressions found from the Observation->EOCustomObject conversion or the new schema/relationships/components - all prior epic work (czs.3-12,16,17,19) already had incremental podman verification throughout, this was the final consolidated confirmation.

Manually verified in staging by user: save-to-journal, DB rows, GCS photo move to permanent path with temp cleanup, BrowseJournal display, entry deletion (cascade + GCS cleanup), and Discard All all confirmed working.

Profile.deleteAccount now cascade-deletes the user's journal data and photos before deleting the Observer: fetches JournalEntries, deletes each Observation's permanent photo via (injectable) PhotoStorageMover first, then deletes the JournalEntry rows (cascading to Observations via the existing DB delete rule) and the Observer in one saveChanges. Photo deletes happen before/alongside the DB delete, not after, so an interrupted request leaks at most a harmless orphaned GCS object rather than a dangling reference.

Also consolidated the to-many-relationship-fault workaround (onthewing-czs.20) into shared finder methods before writing it a third time: +[JournalEntry journalEntriesForObserver:editingContext:] and +[Observation observationsForJournalEntry:editingContext:], both now used by BrowseJournal.m (replacing its former private duplicate implementations) and Profile.m.

New test/TestProfile.m (2 tests: no-op when no user, full cascade verified against real Postgres - user/journalEntry/observations gone from DB, mover called once per photo). Added to GNUmakefile.

Verified: 23/23 suites pass in podman against real Postgres (up from 22 - new TestProfile suite), zero no-DB fallback paths hit.
